method: Independent product, test-sensitivity, record, configuration and history checks; parent semantic review of decisions, source, logs and scope.
limits: Three attempts per named scenario; no universal guarantee for agents, languages, projects or future versions.
Discovery tests stop at the required decision boundary; they do not certify full application scaffolding.
External-outcome tests use a local fixture, not a real deployment. Seeded receipts are historical input, not new product proof.
Raw trial workspaces and logs remain in ignored dist/behavioral-v0.6.0 on the evaluation host; this compact report records outcomes, commands and artifact identities.
